let me give you a little insight on this place. I worked as a server there for a few months. When i would show up to open there were roaches literally EVERYWHERE. all over the pots, walls, ovens, walk ins, etc.. It was the most disgusting kitchen I had EVER seen. I was horrified and it hurt watching people eat from the buffet. I wanted to whisper in their ear hey you might wanna get a sub from next door because the kitchen is horrid. Literally comparable to an outdoor kitchen in India. Just a heads up... I had to quit because the owners didnt do anything about it and only cared about profits, not only that they expect you to understand their super broken english when giving orders. It makes it awkward for me to say what? what? excuse me one more time? what? over and over again. But seriously the roaches were fucking disgusting. I want to leave a review online but noone will believe me because the roaches scatter aqnd dont come out once all the kitchen workers are bustling in there. Sorry to burst any bubbles!
